spec.description:
Foilboard Green Joining Tape is a heavy-duty reinforced aluminum
foil tape engineered with an anti-glare green coating on its outer face to match
the green side of Foilboard Green panels. Coated with an aggressive,
cold-weather acrylic pressure-sensitive adhesive, it creates a continuous
airtight and vapor-tight seal along panel butt joints and penetrations. Designed
specifically for outdoor, roof, and exposed wall applications, it prevents glare
blinding installers while maintaining thermal envelope continuity.
features: Anti-glare green coating matches the green face of Foilboard Green panels
Reinforced aluminum foil backing provides high tensile and tear strength

High-tack pressure-sensitive acrylic adhesive bonds aggressively to foil
facings

Creates an impermeable Class 1 vapor barrier seal across panel
joints
Airtight jointing prevents convective heat loss and air infiltration

Low Flammability Index
(≤ 5) compliant with AS 1530.2

Easy-release paper backing liner for fast
on-site peeling and installation

technical.value:
Reinforced aluminum
foil with anti-glare green lacquer coating

spec.compliance:
AS/NZS 4200.2:2017, AS 1530.2, AS 3959,
NCC Volume One and Two
spec.sustainability:
Low VOC emissions; zero
ozone-depleting potential (ODP)
install:
Ensure Foilboard panel faces are
completely dry, clean, and free of dust, grease, and moisture

Align Foilboard
panels with tightly butted joints

Center the 72mm Green Joining Tape squarely
over the seam with green face outward

Peel back release liner gradually while
applying tape along the joint

Press down firmly along the entire tape length
using a plastic squeegee or roller to activate pressure-sensitive adhesive

Smooth out all wrinkles and air bubbles to guarantee an airtight, vapor-proof
seal
selection_checklist:
Confirm tape color matches the outward-facing
green side of Foilboard Green panels

Select roll width (72mm recommended for
butt joints; 48mm for narrow interfaces)

Calculate total linear meters of
panel seams, corners, and penetrations

Verify ambient application temperature
is above +5°C
limitations:
Surfaces must be completely clean and
dry before taping

Requires firm squeegee pressure to activate permanent
adhesive bond
Not designed for structural load-bearing mechanical fastening
spec.warranty: Covered under Foilboard 25-year performance warranty system

problem_keywords: glare blinding installers on sunny roofs
use_cases:
Sealing butt joints on the
green anti-glare face of Foilboard Green panels in roof installations

Joining
external wall Foilboard panels on exposed, sunny scaffolding where glare
reduction is critical

Sealing panel penetrations and window flashing
interfaces on green-faced Foilboard
retrieval.rag_summary:
Foilboard Green Joining Tape
is a 72mm reinforced aluminum foil tape featuring an anti-glare green coating
and an aggressive acrylic pressure-sensitive adhesive. Designed specifically to
seal butt joints and penetrations on the green face of Foilboard Green panels,
it prevents installer glare in sunny roof and wall installations while
maintaining airtight and vapor-tight integrity. Tested to AS 1530.2 with a low
Flammability Index (≤ 5), it ensures continuous thermal envelope performance
across residential and commercial buildings.
